channel.title: The Bojin Method Journal
channel.description: At-home facial and neck bojin self-care guides by Taiwan-based instructor Yu-Ting Lan.

item.title: What Is Facial Bojin? Method, Sequence, and Comfortable Contact
item.description: An educational introduction to facial bojin (撥筋), how it differs from gua sha, and why gentle placement and sequence matter.

item.title: Begin Here: The 3-Step Bojin Beginner Path
item.description: Learn what the Bojin Method teaches, how to approach a demonstration, and what comfort checks to observe before practicing.

item.title: Brows and Inner Brow: Visual Movement Guide
item.description: Teacher excerpts, movement comparisons, location illustration, and preparation reminders for the inner-brow area.

item.title: Is Bojin Safe? When to Pause and What to Ask Before Trying
item.description: A suitability and precautions overview covering when to pause, comfort checks, and clear non-medical boundaries.

item.title: Gua Sha and Bojin: How They Differ and Fit Together
item.description: Compare tool shape, contact surface, movement direction, and the role of the supporting hand in gua sha vs. facial bojin.
